{{Quote|As a slaver, Gardi has already proved himself to be a lowly individual no better than the Quar rats of the Barancar Port sewers. In his capturing of both the Kashyyyk representatives and Taruan, he has proved himself despicable. I wouldn't mind being the one to throw this scum in the cell waiting for him at the detention facility on Dles IV.|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="AJ8" />}} 
'''Slar-dan ti Gardi''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. While [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] sometime during or after [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he met the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Borun Call]] and began to work with him. Gardi eventually enslaved two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] representatives from the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and sold them off after seeing a [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] about their disappearance. [[Tauran Nartal]], a New Republic [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], headed the investigation into the matter and cornered the Twi'lek on the astronomical object [[Werncin 3]], though Call was able to save his partner. Both sold Nartal into slavery, causing New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to document them in his dossier ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|In a spiteful move, Gardi sold Sergeant Nartal into slavery. Now the New Republic has issued a bounty on Gardi's head and the Twi'lek has gone into hiding, fearing another stint in a prison|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="AJ8" />}}
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] no earlier than [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Slar-dan ti Gardi was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of<ref name="AJ8" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] worked in the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Trade Corridor]], where the bribing of local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers allowed him to carry out his work on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|space lanes]]. When the Empire was defeated on<ref name="AJ8" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]<ref name="AJ8" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Ison Corridor quickly came under the control of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Gardi tried to bribe the first Republic officer he saw, [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Dasha Fanron]]. He failed and Fanron had him [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in a temporary detention facility, an uncomfortable experience for him. There, he met<ref name="AJ8" /> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]<ref name="AJ10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] [[Borun Call]], who introduced him to the trade of the enslaved. In their first operation, the pair captured three [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] escapees from [[Valfin labor camps|labor camps]]<ref name="AJ8" /> in the [[Valfin system/Legends|Valfin system]].<ref name="TEA" /> After making good profit on their work, Gardi became an enslaver.<ref name="AJ8" />

[[File:Borun Call AJ10.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Borun Call (pictured) prevented Gardi's capture by Sergeant Tauran Nartal.]]
Afterwards, he captured the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Krotorra]] and [[Lamorrack]], who were, unbeknownst to him, New Republic representatives from<ref name="AJ8" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. He soon saw a [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] that announced their disappearance, causing him to quickly sell the enslaved to the [[Vax Mining Group]] and flee the region he was in.<ref name="AJ8" /> The New Republic [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] and [[Special forces/Legends|Special forces]] operative [[Tauran Nartal]] headed the investigation and eventually cornered Gardi in [[Jinorota City]] on the astronomical object [[Werncin 3]].<ref name="AJ10" /> Call came across Nartal escorting the Twi'lek and surprised the Sergeant. After Call dispatched him with a [[stun pistol]] shot,<ref name="AJ8" /> Gardi and the Quarren decided to sell Natral to representatives of the [[Mine/Legends|mines]] on<ref name="AJ10" /> the world<ref name="TEA" /> [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="AJ10" />

The enslaving pair still continued their duties in the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and its surrounding territories.<ref name="AJ10" /> The New Republic issued a 45,000-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Twi'lek's head for his actions on Werncin 3, causing him to go into hiding.<ref name="AJ8" /> Call was confident he would not get caught, however.<ref name="AJ10" /> At some point during or after [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> when Gardi was thirty-four, both were documented<ref name="AJ8" /><ref name="AJ10" /> by New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]<ref name="WBC" /> in an update<ref name="WBC1">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> to his dossier ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]''.<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> Gardi's crimes against the Republic were listed as slavery, assault on New Republic personnel, resisting arrest, bribery, [[Thief/Legends|theft]], and kidnapping. A personal addendum by Cracken was also available on the Twi'lek.<ref name="AJ8" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Slar-dan's most noticeable feature is that his left head tail is nearly a half a meter shorter than the right&mdash;Gardi walks with his head titled to right, as he has yet learned to compensate for the missing weight.|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="AJ8" />}}
In his personal addendum, Cracken described Gardi as a despicable and lowly individual who proved himself to be no better than the [[Quar rat|Quar rats]] found on<ref name="AJ8" /> the astronomical object<ref name="XW">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> [[Barancar]]. He also stated he would not mind being the person to imprison the Twi'lek in the detention facility on<ref name="AJ8" /> the rock chunk<ref name="SoSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> [[Dles IV]].<ref name="AJ8" /> Gardi was a gaunt, [[Color/Legends|green]]-blue skinned man who stood at 1.9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. A noticeable feature of his was his left<ref name="AJ8" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lek]] head-[[Limb/Legends|tail]],<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> damged by an enraged [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] the Twi'lek failed to capture. Nearly half a meter of it was missing, causing his head being tilted to the right as he had not adjusted to the missing weight on his head.<ref name="AJ8" />

==Skills and abilities==
Similar to other Twi'leks, Gardi could use his<ref name="AJ8" /> lekku<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> for secret communication among Twi'leks.<ref name="AJ8" /> He also bargained, commanded, and conned when dealing with other beings. A melee combater with good stamina, Gardi employed the use of brawling, brawling parries and dodging. He also could use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The man had some skill in searching and sneaking, demolition, and security, and was informed on [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species, the value of enslaved people, and value in general. Gardi possessed ability with [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], [[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports, and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] gunnery and shields. He could also ride beasts.<ref name="AJ8" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|He dresses in the flowing robes often associated with his people, but his are generally in more soiled and in poorer condition than those usually seen on other Twi'leks.|Airen Cracken in ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="AJ8" />}}
The enslaver armed himself with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]]. He also used manacles, a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and, at some point in his life, wore [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] with a [[Glove/Legends|glove]] and a bracer. The robes he wore were the flowing ones associated with the Twi'leks, though his were soiled and in poor condition&mdash;more so than other members of his species.<ref name="AJ8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slar-dan ti Gardi was first mentioned in the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" department of the [[November]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of'' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The feature was written by [[Craig Robert Carey]], illustrated by [[Robert Duchlinski]], and meant for use in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AJ8" /> "Slar-dan Ti Gardi," an alternate spelling of the character's name, was used as an example name for Twi'leks in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2003]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
